title: Which of four sub-regions a primary health network's quit outreach team works in during 2027, by the patients it helps to quit there, with three measures of existing referrals and the 2025 team's work
subdomain: health-burden-impact-modeling (the quits a cessation programme achieves in each candidate population, from the smokers still smoking when it acts and its own conversion)
prompt_shape: other: one of four sub-regions and its 2027 quits, with a chart of the four, and three asks on the Quitline report and the 2025 team's dialler export
stated_inputs: the 2027 placement: the team calls every active patient the sub-region's practices record as a current smoker in the 30 September 2026 extract, once each, spread evenly through 2027, working as in Eastern Shore in 2025 (placement paper)
a quit is a patient the team calls who sets a quit date and is not smoking four weeks after it, lost to follow-up counted as smoking (placement paper)
a current smoker is a daily, weekly or irregular smoker or a smoker (data dictionary)

sources.origin: generated by task301/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional primary health network in New South Wales with five sub-regions and 61 general practices: each active adult patient's true smoking history as a two-state process at the sub-region's own rates of stopping and relapse, the statuses the practices recorded at consultations from 2012 under two clinical systems' vocabularies, Eastern Shore's 2024 recording drive, the quit outreach team's 2025 list, calls and four-week outcomes, the state Quitline's monthly referral report and the team's dialler export; every organisation, practice and person is invented, and no real dataset is reproduced.
